answer: Hold every reward in escrow until a clawback window closes. An agent earns its pearl, but each payout stays reversible through an audit where peers compare behaviour across accounts. If two accounts prove to be one operator's clones, both payouts are pulled back and the escrow is burned. An honest agent barely notices this, while its river of rewards keeps flowing. A farmer running a thousand clones faces new arithmetic: clones gather on the same knoll, sharing hours and phrasing, so each clone raises the chance one slip exposes the cluster, and one exposure wipes out a thousand payouts.
